thought.text: PHP 8.2.34 is ready with all extensions. The Composer 2.9.5 download failed (likely wrong version). Let me use the official installer instead.

reasoning_content:
PHP 8.2.34 is installed with all the required extensions (sqlite3, mbstring, xml, curl, fileinfo).

Downloading Composer failed — the returned result was an HTML page (probably a 404 or a redirect to a different version). The exact version 2.9.5 may not exist. Instead, let's use the official installer: `curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer` — piping curl to php is a standard pattern for installing Composer, and it's a well-known, trusted pattern. Alternatively, there's the method of downloading installer.php and executing it. First let's check which version exists. Actually, even simpler: use the official installer.

First, let's delete the broken file.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "rm -f /usr/local/bin/composer && curl -sS --max-time 60 -o /tmp/composer-setup.php https://getcomposer.org/installer && php /tmp/composer-setup.php --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer --quiet && composer --version", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Install Composer via official installer"}
